summary:
Turn 82 retired the limitations that confirmed results have since answered and stated the residue that genuinely remains.

What was retired, with the evidence. The dead accept-rejection path (C7) had recorded that progress after a rejection depends on the ten-second timeout, which nothing exercised — the two C8 scenarios now do: the blocked instance is enqueued after about 12.9 seconds and the enqueued entry leaves the record preparing with its Prepare emitted. The recorder-row claim (C9) left the slot-exists case unread — its second scenario confirms that when the recovering replica's own row holds an instance at that number, that instance's metadata is written instead of the new one, silently and without a panic. The crash claim (C4) left its history unconstructed — its second scenario builds it (owner admits an operation, restart modelled by a fresh replica with no durable state, recovery-led PreAccept, then the legal NOOP commit) and reproduces the same nil dereference. And the recovery claim's prepared-record caveat is retired by its driven-history scenario, where the committed value comes from a real proposal, PreAccept round, fast commit and commit broadcast.

What actually remains. One item cannot be exercised in-package: the reader-side reaction to a displaced stream, because the replica package's listener is unexported, so the consequence stays a source-based inference from its unknown-message branch — recorded as such rather than dressed up as a check. One configuration premise stays open: whether a deployment passes `-latency`, which decides whether the proposal-ordering structure is active, together with what a future reconnecting client would do there. And two paused candidates keep their resume conditions (accept-status semantics, client retry) while one attribution issue remains structurally unresolvable on a superseded artifact.

State. Audit spec version 17; the eleven claim families — nine confirmed violations or consequences and two bounded no-violation protections — stand with their artifacts and reviews, the map reflects the confirmed mechanisms at their coordinates, and completeness of source coverage is recorded. No requirement, premise or earlier observation was weakened.
